name: platform object own properties
expression: new Promise(async resolve=>{const stages=[];try{const element=document.createElement('iframe');stages.push(['element',Object.getOwnPropertyNames(element).sort()]);const pc=new RTCPeerConnection();stages.push(['pc',Object.getOwnPropertyNames(pc).sort()]);const dc=pc.createDataChannel('x');stages.push(['dc',Object.getOwnPropertyNames(dc).sort()]);const offer=await pc.createOffer();stages.push(['offer',Object.getOwnPropertyNames(offer).sort()]);stages.push(['storage',Object.getOwnPropertyNames(localStorage).sort()]);pc.close();resolve({stages})}catch(error){resolve({stages,error:{name:error.name,message:error.message,stack:String(error.stack)}})}})
